evidence_snippets: Blended search allows the following fields in search requests : boostSpec contentSearchSpec dataStoreSpecs facetSpecs filter languageCode offset oneBoxPageSize orderBy query pageSize pageToken relevanceScoreSpec relevanceThreshold session sessionSpec spellCorrectionSpec userInfo userPseudoId Blended search allows the following fields in dataStoreSpecs : dataStore boostSpec : If there are boost specs specified for both SearchRequest and dataStoreSpecs , both boost specs are applied to search results filter : If there are filters specified for both SearchRequest and dataStoreSpecs , both filters are applied to search results Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD) operations on serving configs are supported for blended apps.

Only the following fields can be added or updated in a serving config: boostControlIds displayName filterControlIds genericConfig : contentSearchSpec name solutionType synonymsControlIds CRUD operations on the following controls are supported for blended search apps: boostAction synonymAction filterAction There is a limit of 50 data stores per search app.
